title: +PROFESSIONALISM AND LEADERSHIP IN PUBLIC HEALTH
description: Explores health professions across clinical, community, and public health settings through speaker events, job shadowing, and informational interviewing. Employs strategies for internship and career development, including communication, professionalism, leadership, and critical thinking. Analyzes skills, strengths, and experiences to apply toward resume building and cover letter writing.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: CORE 100, 300, BA 100, 300, ED 100, 300, LA 100, 300, SCI 100, 300, ENGR 110, 110H, 310 or minimum score of 1 in 'Baccalaureate Core Student'.
A minimum grade of D- is required in CORE 100, CORE 300, BA 100, BA 300, ED 100, ED 300, LA 100, LA 300, SCI 100, SCI 300, ENGR 110, ENGR 110H and ENGR 310.
